response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and backend systems, strong testing/craftsmanship culture, and demonstrated mentoring through workshops, courses and open-source leadership. However, the role's core hard requirement — 8 years of C++ programming — is not met; the resume shows roughly six months of C/C++ work at National Instruments plus a university thesis project, with the bulk of his career in TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. Similarly, experience with large-scale cloud compute platforms, distributed infrastructure and hardware/storage architecture is limited (the Sociomantic low-latency microservices work is the closest fit), and there is no formal technical leadership role mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers. The profile is a strong product/full-stack engineer rather than a C++ systems platform lead.
strengths: 15+ years of broad engineering experience, including staff-level roles and founding an open-source platform
Strong engineering-practice culture: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, plus authored testing tools and libraries
Proven mentoring and knowledge-sharing via conference talks, multi-module courses and workshops
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience versus the 8-year minimum
Limited large-scale cloud/compute platform and distributed infrastructure ownership
No formal technical leadership role leading cloud or DevOps engineering teams

key_factors.factor: Mentoring, engineering practices and seniority breadth
